title: L0-08 · ‎ف ق ك هand the tāʾ marbūṭa

blocks.text: L0-08 · ⁧ف ق ك ه⁩ and the tāʾ marbūṭa

With ⁧ف ق ك ه⁩ you know all the 28 alphabet letters. Add the tāʾ marbūṭa ⁧ة⁩ , the most common termination of feminine, and the distinction between q and k, which dialects treat in different ways. The vocabulary of this unit is that of the institutions: state, government, law, police, investigation.

rows: 6 hours · one week at a standard pace

blocks.text: Materials This unit, calligraphy L0-08, Anki deck (tag L0-08)
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognize and write ⁧ف ق ك ه⁩ in all forms, including the four forms of ⁧ه⁩ ;
2. to pronounce q uvular distinct from k, and h always audible;
3. write and read ⁧ة⁩ , with the pronunciation -a paused and -at in the construct;
5. to read, write and translate the institutional vocabulary of unity.

rows: ⁧ك⁩ and ⁧ه⁩ · the four forms of ⁧ه⁩ · financial years 1–2

blocks.text: • Sound. /f/, deaf labiodental fricativa, like Italian f.
• Tracked. A round eyelet with a point above; in isolated and final forms the eyelet prolongs in a flat base on line.

• Note for maghrebini documents. In the traditional writing of Maghreb ⁧ف⁩ has the point below ( ⁧ڡ⁩ ) e ⁧ق⁩ a only point above ( ⁧ڧ⁩ ). You can still find it on signs, handwritten documents and religious texts of North Africa: don't confuse that ⁧ق⁩ with a ⁧ف⁩ .
• Sound. /q/, occlusive deaf uvular: the back of the tongue closes against the uvula, further back than k. Nearby vowels darken slightly.
• How it is produced. Speak ka, ka, ka by moving the contact further and further back, until you hear the closure in bottom of the mouth: qa.
• Tracked. Eyelet with two points above; isolated and final descend into a deep cup below the line (other than flat base of ⁧ف⁩ ).
• Regional variation. In Cairo and in the cities of the Levant ⁧ق⁩ becomes a glottis [ʔ] (qalb→ ʾalb); in
Gulf, among the Bedouins and in Upper Egypt often [g]. In MSA remains /q/.
• Sound. /k/, the c of the house.
• Tracked. Insulated and final: a high rod with a horizontal base and a small zigzag sign inside.
Initial and median: high inclined rod with horizontal section, without zigzag.
• Sound. /h/, glottidal fricative: a true h, always pronounced, even at the end of the word. In Italian la h non is never pronounced: it is the error to avoid.
• Forms. Four very different shapes: isolated ⁧ه⁩ (a round eyelet), initial ⁧هـ⁩ (one eyelet with two Midway through the eyes ⁧ـهـ⁩ (a node crossing the line), final ⁧ـه⁩ (a little eyelet hanging).
• Examples ⁧هُوَ⁩ huwa ... he... ⁧هِيَ⁩ hiya ... ⁧وَجْه⁩ waǧh "Time" is the name of the novel.
• ⁧ه⁩ against ⁧ح⁩ . Glottis versus Pharynges: ⁧هَرَم⁩ haram •pyramid • ⁧حَرَم⁩ ḥaram Sacred enclosure.

What is it? A variant of ⁧ت⁩ which appears only at the end of a word: it has the form of ⁧ه⁩ with the two points of ⁧ت⁩ ( ⁧ة⁩ isolated, ⁧ـة⁩ Final). The name means "t legacies." It is not an autonomous letter of the alphabet. What's it for? Above all, it marks the female: ⁧مَدِينَة⁩ madīna "City' means any of the following: ⁧دَوْلَة⁩ dawla ... state. ⁧شُرْطَة⁩ šurṭa "Police" is the name of the "Police."
